correctness.rationale: For n>=2 the retained body K_n^- obeys -1<=t<=0 and t+sqrt(n²-1)||y||<=n. The uniqueness of maximal inscribed ellipsoids and O(n-1) transverse invariance force axial semiaxis a, radial semiaxis b and center -s, with 0<s<1. Exact support-function containment is a<=min(s,1-s), b²<=((n+s)²-a²)/(n²-1). The logarithmic volume derivative in a is positive over the feasible domain, forcing a=min(s,1-s); along s<=1/2 the remaining volume strictly increases, and along s>=1/2 it strictly decreases, by the derivatives printed in RESULT.md. Unique optimizer s=a=1/2,b=sqrt(n/(n-1)). The volume ratio to the unit ball equals 1/2 (n/(n-1))^((n-1)/2), conditional on the original primary theorem J(K_n)=B_2^n. I rechecked the algebra and all boundary cases n=2 and s=1/2; no finite numerical maximization is used.
